title: Cubeclash-pvp-event
description: A PvP event datapack for Minecraft 26.1 with start phase, grace phase, final and winner animation.
body:
**CubeClash PvP Event** is a PvP event pack for Minecraft that provides a complete multi-phase last-player-standing event system with automated setup, join handling, world border control, combat rules, and winner detection.

It is built for organized server events and includes functions to manage the full event flow from preparation to the final battle.

**Features**

- full event phase system
  - setup
  - prejoin
  - map opening
  - PvP activation
  - finale
  - winner sequence
- bossbar support
- world border control
- join and respawn handling
- combat logging detection
- temporary ban / punishment logic
- automatic winner detection
- admin functions for setup and control

**Commands**

- "/function cubeclash:admin/setup" — creates the required scoreboards, teams, and base systems for the event
- "/function cubeclash:admin/set_anchor" — sets the anchor point used for teleports and event flow
- "/function cubeclash:admin/prejoin" — starts the prejoin phase so players can join the event
- "/function cubeclash:admin/open_map" — opens the map or starts the next event phase
- "/function cubeclash:admin/pvp_on" — enables PvP for the combat phase
- "/function cubeclash:admin/finale" — starts the final phase of the event
- "/function cubeclash:admin/reset" — resets the event and clears active states

**Note**

This project is intended for structured PvP server events and should be fully configured before public use.
